title: Build a block-count-robust English<->locale code-block matcher (anchor on heading text + content similarity, not raw positional index)
evidence_refs: Built scripts/pipeline/lib/example_verification/block_matcher.py: position fast-path for equal block counts (the common case), greedy best-similarity fallback (difflib.SequenceMatcher on raw block content) for count-mismatched pages, never forcing a low-confidence match (reports 'unmatched' instead of guessing). Verified live against real content: correctly re-orders a real 3-vs-4 block-count mismatch (docs.aspose.org 3d/net installation.md, ar locale) that naive positional pairing gets wrong. 6 unit tests (test_block_matcher.py), all pass. Committed as part of 3f9aa582abcc85abc7b6702e159eab889cee3181.

title: Dry-run a tag-only fixer for the confirmed ST-211 tag-mistranslation class using TC-01's matcher -- report only, no writes
evidence_refs: Built scripts/pipeline/commands/governance/locale_tag_mistranslation_fixer.py using TC-01's matcher; dry-run against the full portfolio found 271 candidates (matching TC-19's own narrow criteria exactly -- English tag NON_EXECUTABLE_LANGS, locale tag real+checkable, locale content genuinely SYNTAX-ERROR under its current wrong tag). All 271 matched via 'position' (equal block counts); zero via the new content-similarity fallback, which corrected this taskcard's own understanding: the earlier '88% reference.aspose.org' estimate was a plausibility correlation, not a verified count (see the correction appended to MT072/TC-19's own report). Found + fixed a real bug while building this: apply_fix() lacked newline='' on write, which would have widened LF to CRLF across the WHOLE file on Windows (git's own text=auto normalization happened to absorb this in the real run, but the working-tree copy would be left wrong) -- fixed, with a regression test. 10 unit tests (test_locale_tag_mistranslation_fixer.py), all pass. Registered in registry.yaml. Committed as part of 3f9aa582abcc85abc7b6702e159eab889cee3181.
